---
title: "Flow cytometry ridge plots — DNA content and cell size (SFig)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r constants}
# Strain display labels and colours
STRAIN_LABELS <- c("WT"      = "WT",
                   "RIM15Δ0" = "rim15Δ",
                   "DGY1"    = "WT (haploid ctrl)",
                   "DGY3"    = "Diploid ctrl")

COND_LABELS <- c("C" = "Carbon starvation",
                 "N" = "Nitrogen starvation",
                 "P" = "Phosphorus starvation")

TIME_COLORS <- c("DGY3 ctrl" = "#cccccc",
                 "DGY1 ctrl" = "#999999",
                 "0 h"  = "#fef0d9",
                 "6 h"  = "#fdcc8a",
                 "16 h" = "#fc8d59",
                 "30 h" = "#b30000")

out_dir <- "./revision3/output"
```

```{r load-dna}
b2a_raw <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir, "dna_b2a_raw.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Strain  = recode(Strain, "RIM15Δ0" = "rim15Δ"),
    # Build ridge label: controls at top, timepoints below
    ridge = case_when(
      Strain == "Diploid ctrl" ~ "DGY3 ctrl",   # diploid: 2N/4N markers
      Strain %in% c("WT (haploid ctrl)", "DGY1") ~ "DGY1 ctrl",
      TRUE ~ paste0(Time, " h")
    ),
    # Ordered factor: DGY3 top, DGY1 next, then T0→T30 from top to bottom
    ridge = factor(ridge,
                   levels = rev(c("DGY3 ctrl", "DGY1 ctrl",
                                  "0 h", "6 h", "16 h", "30 h")))
  ) %>%
  # Keep only experimental strains + controls for the ridge plots
  dplyr::filter(Strain %in% c("WT", "rim15Δ") |
                  grepl("ctrl", ridge, fixed = TRUE))
```

```{r load-fsc}
fsc_raw <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir, "fsc_raw.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Strain = recode(Strain, "RIM15Δ0" = "rim15Δ"),
    ridge  = case_when(
      Strain %in% c("WT (haploid ctrl)", "DGY1") ~ "DGY1 ctrl",
      TRUE ~ paste0(Time, " h")
    ),
    ridge  = factor(ridge,
                    levels = rev(c("DGY1 ctrl", "0 h", "6 h", "16 h", "30 h")))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Strain %in% c("WT", "rim15Δ") |
                  grepl("ctrl", ridge, fixed = TRUE))
```

## DNA content ridge plots

One panel per genotype × condition. Controls (diploid DGY3 and haploid DGY1) appear at
the top as landmarks for the 1N and 2N peak positions. Timepoints run top to bottom.

```{r dna-ridge-plots, fig.height=10}
make_dna_ridge <- function(genotype, condition) {
  # Controls are shared across conditions — no Media filter for them
  ctrl <- b2a_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("ctrl", ridge, fixed = TRUE))

  expt <- b2a_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(Strain == genotype, Media == condition)

  df <- bind_rows(ctrl, expt)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = value, y = ridge, fill = ridge, color = ridge)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.5,
                        bandwidth = 500,
                        rel_min_height = 0.005) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1e5),
                       labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = TIME_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = TIME_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    labs(x     = "SYTOX Green fluorescence (B2-A)",
         y     = NULL,
         title = paste0(genotype, " — ", COND_LABELS[condition])) +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
}

conditions <- c("C", "N", "P")
genotypes  <- c("WT", "rim15Δ")

dna_plots <- map(genotypes, function(gt) {
  map(conditions, function(cond) make_dna_ridge(gt, cond))
}) %>% unlist(recursive = FALSE)

dna_page <- plot_grid(plotlist = dna_plots, ncol = 3, nrow = 2,
                      labels = paste0(rep(c("WT", "rim15Δ"), each = 3),
                                      " — ", rep(c("C", "N", "P"), 2)),
                      label_size = 9)
dna_page

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "sfig_dna_ridges.pdf"),
       dna_page, width = 12, height = 9)
message("Saved sfig_dna_ridges.pdf")
```

## Cell size ridge plots

```{r fsc-ridge-plots, fig.height=9}
make_fsc_ridge <- function(genotype, condition) {
  ctrl <- fsc_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("ctrl", ridge, fixed = TRUE))

  expt <- fsc_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(Strain == genotype, Media == condition)

  df <- bind_rows(ctrl, expt)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = value, y = ridge, fill = ridge, color = ridge)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.5,
                        rel_min_height = 0.005) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits   = c(0, 2e6),
                       labels   = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = TIME_COLORS[names(TIME_COLORS) != "DGY3 ctrl"],
                      guide   = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = TIME_COLORS[names(TIME_COLORS) != "DGY3 ctrl"],
                       guide  = "none") +
    labs(x     = "FSC-A (cell size)",
         y     = NULL,
         title = paste0(genotype, " — ", COND_LABELS[condition])) +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
}

fsc_plots <- map(genotypes, function(gt) {
  map(conditions, function(cond) make_fsc_ridge(gt, cond))
}) %>% unlist(recursive = FALSE)

fsc_page <- plot_grid(plotlist = fsc_plots, ncol = 3, nrow = 2,
                      labels = paste0(rep(c("WT", "rim15Δ"), each = 3),
                                      " — ", rep(c("C", "N", "P"), 2)),
                      label_size = 9)
fsc_page

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "sfig_fsc_ridges.pdf"),
       fsc_page, width = 12, height = 8)
message("Saved sfig_fsc_ridges.pdf")
```
